description: Explicit construction and full-replacement schedule for infrastructure exchanges already quantified per tonne in the source-derived foreground. Scheduling preserves each component's campaign-average inventory amount.

components.basis: Original workbook comment: two heat exchangers per recovery unit, changed every three years; construction remains an explicit cutoff until equipment mass/provider is supplied.
One construction event over the campaign when a new injection site is selected; the central North Sea site is existing and therefore has zero drilling demand.
Transparent engineering lifetime for the webinar extension; quantity is reconstructed from the cited open PEM inventory.
Transparent stack replacement interval for the webinar extension.
Transparent compressor-module replacement interval; the custom activity retains its explicit subcomponents.
One tank construction event over the thirty-year campaign.
One facility construction event over the thirty-year campaign.

explicit_cutoffs: No separate capture-plant construction exchange is quantified in the original workbook.
No separate methanol-to-jet facility construction exchange is quantified in the original workbook.
Heat-pump infrastructure is not quantified; electricity use is represented annually.
